title: Explicit canonical comparison bundle for pulled-back chart refinement
statement: Given schemes X,Y,Z,W [def-pc-scheme], maps q:Y→X, v:Z→X, h:W→X, pk:W→Y, pl:W→Z with pk≫q=h and pl≫v=h, an open cover U of X and a chart index a, form Uk=U pulled back along q, Ul=U pulled back along v, Vk=Uk pulled back along pk, Vl=Ul pulled back along pl. Supply d:Ul(a)→Uk(a) commuting with the maps to U(a), and z:Vl(a)→Vk(a) commuting both with d and with the maps to W. Write D,Pk,Pl,Zf,Rk,Rl for the ordinary module pullbacks along d,Vk→Uk,Vl→Ul,z,Vk→W,Vl→W [def-pc-module-pullback]; write Lk=q* followed by restriction to Uk(a), Ll=v* followed by restriction to Ul(a), and T=h*, using tensor pullback. Define openCoverRefinementComparisons to be the tuple (alpha,beta,delta,ck,cl) of isomorphisms Ll≅Lk⋙D, Rk⋙Zf≅Rl, Pk⋙Zf≅D⋙Pl, T⋙Rk≅Lk⋙Pk, T⋙Rl≅Ll⋙Pl, with alpha built from chart comparisons [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison] and pullback composition/congruence along d, beta and delta from ordinary composition/congruence along z, and ck,cl from tensor composition [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] and inverse chart comparison. The tuple is the explicit Lean construction; it asserts no coherence property. The two recovery comparisons ck and cl use the explicit composite [def-pc-module-recovery-comparison-iso] to share its expression with the categorical recovery calculation.

lean.statement:
def openCoverRefinementComparisons
    {X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (v : Z ⟶ X) (h : W ⟶ X)
    (pk : W ⟶ Y) (pl : W ⟶ Z) (wk : pk ≫ q = h) (wl : pl ≫ v = h)
    (U : X.OpenCover.{u}) (a : U.I₀)
    (d : (U.pullback₁ v).X a ⟶ (U.pullback₁ q).X a)
    (hd : d ≫ U.pullbackHom q a = U.pullbackHom v a)
    (z : ((U.pullback₁ v).pullback₁ pl).X a ⟶
      ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ pk).X a)
    (hz : z ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) pk a =
      Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ v) pl a ≫ d)
    (hz0 : z ≫ ((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ pk).f a =
      ((U.pullback₁ v).pullback₁ pl).f a)
    :
    let Uk : Y.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ q
    let Ul : Z.OpenCover.{u} := U.pullback₁ v
    let Vk : W.OpenCover.{u} := Uk.pullback₁ pk
    let Vl : W.OpenCover.{u} := Ul.pullback₁ pl
    let D := pullback d
    let Pk := pullback (Uk.pullbackHom pk a)
    let Pl := pullback (Ul.pullbackHom pl a)
    let Zf := pullback z
    let Rk := pullback (Vk.f a)
    let Rl := pullback (Vl.f a)
    let Lk := tensorPullback q ⋙ pullback (Uk.f a)
    let Ll := tensorPullback v ⋙ pullback (Ul.f a)
    (Ll ≅ Lk ⋙ D) × (Rk ⋙ Zf ≅ Rl) × (Pk ⋙ Zf ≅ D ⋙ Pl) ×
      (tensorPullback h ⋙ Rk ≅ Lk ⋙ Pk) × (tensorPullback h ⋙ Rl ≅ Ll ⋙ Pl)
